<ic>Commission follow-up research regarding the Skarsind Runeforge, as suggested by Peter of Hintown<br><br>
''Approved by the Minister of Historical Research.''</ic>

===Overview===
* The research was commissioned by Palladius of Urizen
* [[Historical research]] concerning this topic has been commissioned through the civil service.
* Action approved by the [[Minister of Historical Research]].

===Date===
* Autumn Equinox 379YE

===Progress===
* 5 Thrones provided after Autumn Equinox 379YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* A small expedition has been dispatched to western [[Sermersuaq]] to engage in direct investigation of sites there relevant to Peter of Hintown's theory.
